\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Curvature scale separates $p_k$ and $q_k$] In the contradiction sequence above, \[ d_0(p_k,q_k)^2Q_k\longrightarrow \infty . \] \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch ↗ lem:uniform-curvature-bound-kappa-solution If the products were bounded, then $d_0(p_k,q_k)\to \infty $ would force $Q_k\to 0$. In the $Q_k$-rescaled flows, $p_k$ stays at bounded distance from $q_k$ but has scalar curvature $Q_k^{-1}\to \infty $, contradicting the uniform curvature bound near a normalized base point.

□

Corollary
[Non-compact $\kappa $-solutions are (capped) strong tubes]
